witness_pages: Várias histórias.djvu, pages 15–35 (printed pp. 9–29), complete A CARTOMANTE
notes: Complete AI-assisted transcription and a separate full proofreading comparison against the page images passed for 58/58 units after the stated normalization. Each source paragraph was also read for continuity, beginning/end boundaries and the translation assessment. This is an AI-assisted technical check of the identified electronic witness, not independent human review or a new physical-facsimile collation.
normalization_decisions: Running heads, page numbers, ornaments and the chapter title excluded; drop-cap HAMLET written Hamlet; line-end hyphenation joined; italics not marked.

Paragraph-initial dialogue dashes written “— ”, internal dashes written with surrounding spaces; spaces printed before ; : ? ! removed; a space added where print omits one after a comma; curly apostrophes written as '; obvious run-together print (umaauma, nema um, compridase) separated.

Historical spelling, accents and variants kept as printed, including Vem / Vèm / Vêm, Guarda-Velha / Guarda Velha and Dahi / D'ahi. Two marks judged to be type damage (dura a aleivosia; estirou-o) are read without accents.
